headline: Ghanaian Processor Usibras Imports Ivorian Cashew Kernels
summary: Leading Ghanaian cashew processor Usibras resorted to importing semi-processed cashew kernels from Côte d’Ivoire to keep its factory operational amid domestic agro-processing pressures.
why: Supply chain adjustments by agricultural processors highlight local crop shortages and cross-border trade dependencies within regional commodity markets.
